new-plymouth-7.name: Wind Wand
new-plymouth-7.bio: A 45 m red kinetic tube by Len Lye on the Coastal Walkway that bends in the wind and glows at night.
notes: Wikipedia gives 48 m overall, Wikivoyage 45 m for the tube; bio uses 45 m tube. No ticketUrl: council walkway sculpture.

new-plymouth-8.name: Fitzroy Beach
new-plymouth-8.bio: A surf beach on Surf Highway 45 with summer lifesaving patrols, and a 2007 Blue Flag beach.
notes: HELD: needs a photo. No Wikipedia article. Current Blue Flag status and patrol dates unverified.

new-plymouth-9.name: East End Beach
new-plymouth-9.bio: A sheltered beach with summer surf lifesaving patrols, becoming known for kite-surfing.
notes: HELD: needs a photo. 'East End Beach' redirects to Munjoy Hill, Maine, so no wiki; the photo needs an override.

new-plymouth-10.name: Ngāmotu Beach
new-plymouth-10.bio: A calm, sheltered swimming beach beside Port Taranaki and the Sugar Loaf Islands.
notes: HELD: needs a photo. No Wikipedia article.

new-plymouth-11.name: Sugar Loaf Islands
new-plymouth-11.bio: Five small islands and sea stacks off Port Taranaki, seen from shore or by wildlife boat trip.
notes: Free = viewing from shore (Paritutu, Coastal Walkway); boat trips are paid third-party extras, no price verified. Landing on the islands is by permit only, so not stated in the bio.

new-plymouth-12.name: Lake Mangamahoe
new-plymouth-12.bio: A 6 km circuit around a lake through forest, with lookouts and redwoods planted in 1931.
notes: Coordinates moved to the main car park (OSM). Whether NPDC hours are gate times is unverified. No Wikipedia article.

new-plymouth-13.name: Ōakura Beach
new-plymouth-13.bio: A black-sand surf beach on Surf Highway 45, among Oceania's first Blue Flag beaches in 2007.
notes: No article for the beach (Ōakura is the township), so no wiki. Current Blue Flag status unverified.

new-plymouth-14.name: Waimoku Track
new-plymouth-14.bio: An advanced 3.5 km DOC track from Lucy's Gully up to Patuhā Trig, with coast and mountain views.
notes: HELD: needs a photo. DOC gives 2 h to the trig; the 3.5-5 h range is an estimate. Final ~100 m is an exposed scramble (not in bio). No Wikipedia article.

new-plymouth-15.name: Pukeiti
new-plymouth-15.bio: A rhododendron garden with 26 ha of gardens, open all day with free entry.
notes: HELD: needs a photo. Cafe days unverified.

egmont-6.name: Around the Mountain Circuit
egmont-6.bio: A 52 km, four-to-five-day loop around Taranaki Maunga, with DOC huts and unbridged rivers.
notes: Track free; huts are bookable (Holly Hut about NZD 25-34 per night; other huts not read). Check DOC alerts for section closures (2023 Stony River/Hangatahua closure reported). Start moved to North Egmont car park. Photo is external (Flickr).

egmont-7.name: Manganui Gorge Track
egmont-7.bio: A short DOC walk to a 100 m suspension bridge, 49.5 m above Manganui Gorge.
notes: Range is an estimate (DOC: about 30 min each way). Start moved to The Plateau car park.

egmont-8.name: Manganui Ski Area
egmont-8.bio: A club ski field on Taranaki Maunga with three rope tows and a T-bar for beginners.
notes: Full-day adult lift pass NZD 50 (club prices page); no hire on site. Season dates and daily hours not on pages read.

three-sisters-tongaporutu.name: Three Sisters and Elephant Rock
three-sisters-tongaporutu.bio: Sea stacks at the Tongapōrutu River mouth, reached on foot at low tide.
notes: Standalone. No ticketUrl (no steward page found). Safe tide window unsourced and left out; land manager unknown. Point is the stacks; car park is 1.1 km east.
